snippet.title: Poptropica Legacy - Gameplay Preview
snippet.description:
DOWNLOAD HERE: https://www.poptropicalegacy.com/

Poptropica Legacy is a fan-made desktop version of our favorite game! This is a recreation of both the AS2 version - the first one from 2007, including the 37 original island quests - AND the AS3 version - also known as the SUI version within the community, including 14 island quests of it’s own plus Poptropica: Realms - with more than a few major changes/improvements.

DISCLAIMER: This project is in active development, and there are many bugs - temper expectations accordingly.

Join our Discord to download: https://discord.gg/CSPt8xejuB
